court: District of Columbia Court of Appeals

issues.label: Sufficiency of evidence for ADW count
issues.why: Davis challenges whether evidence supported one ADW conviction, requiring review of the elements against the record.

issues.label: Identification of Davis as the gunman
issues.why: The case hinges on whether the prosecution proved Davis, not just his car, was the shooter.

issues.label: Admissibility of Johnson's car identification
issues.why: Court must assess lay opinion testimony identifying the Maserati from video features.

issues.label: Admissibility of rim-color-change testimony
issues.why: Johnson's account of Davis seeking to change wheel color may be challenged as prejudicial or improperly admitted.

issues.label: Reliability of eyewitness photo array ID
issues.why: Nance's identification eight days later may raise suggestiveness or reliability concerns.

issues.label: Admissibility of CSLI evidence
issues.why: Cell site location data admission may require foundation and Fourth Amendment (warrant) scrutiny.

issues.label: Flight as consciousness of guilt
issues.why: Evidence of Davis fleeing to Costa Rica and covered Maserati raises flight-inference instruction issues.

issues.label: Merger of ADW and AWIKWA counts
issues.why: Court must ensure separate convictions do not violate double jeopardy for the same conduct.

issues.label: Merger of PFCOV convictions
issues.why: Whether four PFCOV counts properly merged and were correctly sentenced.

issues.label: Consecutive sentencing propriety
issues.why: Court must review legality of stacking four sentences consecutively for 390 months.

issues.label: Intent to kill element
issues.why: AWIKWA requires proof of specific intent to kill Nance.

issues.label: Intent element for ADW victims
issues.why: ADW against children and rear-car victim requires proof of requisite intent or general intent as to each.

issues.label: Transferred intent doctrine
issues.why: Whether intent toward Nance transfers to child and bystander victims affects convictions.

issues.label: Standard of review for evidentiary errors
issues.why: Court must apply abuse-of-discretion and harmless-error standards to preserved/unpreserved claims.

issues.label: Preservation of objections at trial
issues.why: Whether Davis preserved evidentiary and sentencing arguments affects the applicable review standard.

issues.label: Chain of custody for ballistic evidence
issues.why: Bullet fragments removed from Nance must be properly authenticated and linked.

issues.label: Prejudicial effect of covered Maserati evidence
issues.why: Discovery of tarp-covered car may be probative but risks unfair prejudice.

issues.label: Sufficiency of injury/dangerous weapon proof
issues.why: ADW requires proof a dangerous weapon was used and capable of causing harm to each victim.
